chapters.title: The King Deposes Queen Vashti
chapters.synopsis: King Ahasuerus holds a lavish feast at Susa displaying his wealth, followed by a seven-day banquet for all the people. When Queen Vashti refuses his summons to appear, his counselors advise deposing her as an example to all wives.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Ahasuerus holds a great feast at Susa

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Vashti refuses the king and is deposed

chapters.title: Esther Becomes Queen
chapters.synopsis: Young women are gathered before the king, and Esther, raised by her cousin Mordecai, finds favor and is crowned queen without revealing her Jewish identity. Mordecai later uncovers and reports a plot to assassinate the king.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Esther is chosen and crowned queen

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Mordecai exposes a plot against the king

chapters.title: Haman's Plot Against the Jews
chapters.synopsis: Haman is advanced above all the princes, and when Mordecai refuses to bow to him, Haman resolves to destroy all the Jews of the kingdom. He casts lots for the date and secures a royal decree for their annihilation.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Haman is enraged that Mordecai will not bow

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Haman secures a decree to destroy the Jews

chapters.title: For Such a Time as This
chapters.synopsis: Mordecai mourns publicly and sends word urging Esther to plead for her people before the king. Esther fears to approach him unbidden, but Mordecai warns that deliverance will come from elsewhere if she stays silent, and she asks all the Jews to fast for her.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Mordecai mourns and appeals to Esther

segments.speaker: mordecai
segments.note: Who knoweth whether thou art come for such a time

segments.speaker: esther
segments.note: Esther asks the Jews to fast for her

chapters.title: Esther's Banquet Invitation
chapters.synopsis: Esther approaches the king unbidden and is graciously received, inviting him and Haman to a private banquet. Elated yet still enraged at Mordecai, Haman has gallows built to hang him.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Esther is received and invites the king to a banquet

chapters.title: The King Honors Mordecai
chapters.synopsis: Unable to sleep, the king reads the chronicles and learns Mordecai was never rewarded for exposing the assassination plot. He commands the humiliated Haman to honor Mordecai publicly through the city streets.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Haman is forced to honor Mordecai before the city

chapters.title: Haman Exposed and Hanged
chapters.synopsis: At her second banquet Esther reveals her Jewish identity and exposes Haman's murderous plot to the king. In his fury the king orders Haman hanged on the very gallows built for Mordecai.

segments.speaker: esther
segments.note: Esther exposes Haman's plot to the king

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Haman is hanged on his own gallows

chapters.title: Mordecai's Decree of Defense
chapters.synopsis: The king gives Haman's estate to Esther and promotes Mordecai to his former place. Since the first decree cannot be revoked, a new decree permits the Jews throughout the empire to defend themselves against their enemies.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Mordecai is raised to Haman's former place

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: A new decree lets the Jews defend themselves

chapters.title: Deliverance and the Feast of Purim
chapters.synopsis: On the appointed day the Jews defend themselves and prevail decisively over their enemies throughout the provinces. Mordecai and Esther establish the annual Feast of Purim to commemorate their deliverance.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: The Jews defend themselves and prevail

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Purim is established to commemorate deliverance

chapters.title: Mordecai's Greatness Recorded
chapters.synopsis: King Ahasuerus's greatness is recorded in the chronicles of Media and Persia. The account also preserves Mordecai's rise to power and his continued care for the welfare of his people.

segments.speaker: chronicler
segments.note: Mordecai's greatness and service are recorded
